details: The brush handler fires `render()` on every mousemove via `.on('brush end', onBrush)` with no debouncing or requestAnimationFrame, causing a full DOM mutation of 35 bars, dependency arrows, grid lines, and axis ticks at 60fps during drag. No transitions are used anywhere so there is no handoff race; pointer events unify mouse/touch avoiding double-triggers; and xMain is mutated in-place so scale references stay fresh.
